notes.title: Build 204 Released! Mega Content Update featuring a BONUS WORLD, Story, Achievements and more!
notes.notes:
Here it is folks, the build you've all been waiting for, even if you didn't know you were supposed to be waiting!  

Build 204 has the following features:

[list]
[*]21 new maps as part of our Bonus World update!  These are some of the best, and most devious puzzles ever devised for Burnstar.  Play at your own peril!  You don't have to have completed the original adventure to try them out either.  The new maps have new visual themes too!
[*]An in game story!  Featuring inter-level cutscenes with character banter and Type-o-maticTM(not really) dialog.  The story has been localized into all our supported languages as well.  
[*]29 new music tracks!  The new tracks have been added to the existing levels as well as the new secret maps
[*]6 new achievements!  They're hard to get, so wear them with pride!
[*]Voice acting!  All the denizens of Fairway Island speak their own language though, so they might be hard to understand.
[*]Tons of bug fixes and little enhancements, way too many to list out!
[/list]

notes.title: Build 192 Released! (with a surprise!)
notes.notes:
Just some bug fixes this time...

...oh and LEADERBOARDS!

  -	Leaderboards for every level
      The way this works is there are two leaderboards per level, per game mode.  For each level there is an "any %" completion board (just the absolute quickest time) and the "all gold" board (fastest time while getting all stars, burning everything, and getting under par!).  There are separate any % and all gold leaderboards for single player and co-op.

  -	All times now display sub second times
      The increase precision was necessary for people fighting for the top leaderboard positions
      
  -	Mouse cursor now defaults to hidden and hides after an inactive period when in full screen in menus 

  -	Rockets fired through a reflector in co-op should remember who fired them for star spawning.
  
  -	Fix for teleporting boo blocks when on conveyors.

notes.title: Build 188 Released!
notes.notes:
Burnstar build 188 is now live on steam!ːToxoː  This build includes the following changes:

- Fix for crash that could occur when restarting level while controling Coldnsap's wisp
- Character abilities are now precached (should eliminate hitches when first using your ability)
- Incinerators now initially start with the correct "off" model
- Crushers now break breakable blocks when returning
- Toxo's clone now always faces the direction of the player when spawned
- Only players can activate tutorial switches (formerly, toxo's clone could activate tutorial switches, oops!)
- Made hidden elements in a couple Forest and Mines levels a bit easier to see and find
- Fixed a sapling that was too easy to get in labs
- New car smell
